traditional: 一時 A 一時 B
jyutping: jat1 si4 A jat1 si4 B

english.note: Use this colloquial pattern when describing two conditions or types of terrain that keep varying or alternating.

examples.english: As I drive along this road, I alternate between flat and steep stretches, so I have to be careful.
examples.traditional: 呢條路一時平一時斜，揸車要好小心。
examples.jyutping: nei1 tiu4 lou6 jat1 si4 ping4 jat1 si4 ce4 zaa1 ce1 jiu3 hou2 siu2 sam1
